dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Nam, I called you yesterday afternoon. What were you doing?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, aɪ ˈkɔːld juː ˈjɛstərdeɪ ˌæftərˈnuːn. ˈwʌt wɜːr juː ˈduːɪŋ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Sorry, Mr. Brown. I was coming home from Japan.
dialogue.reading: ˈsɑːri, ˈmɪstər ˈbraʊn. aɪ wʌz ˈkʌmɪŋ ˈhoʊm frəm dʒəˈpæn.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Oh! Were you on the plane at three o'clock?
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ! wɜːr juː ɑːn ðə ˈpleɪn ət ˈθriː əˈklɑːk?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: No, we were sitting at the gate in Osaka. Our flight was late.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, wiː wɜːr ˈsɪtɪŋ ət ðə ˈɡeɪt ɪn oʊˈsɑːkə. aʊər ˈflaɪt wʌz ˈleɪt.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: I see. What time did you land in Bangkok?
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈsiː. ˈwʌt ˈtaɪm dɪd juː ˈlænd ɪn ˈbæŋkɑːk?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: At eleven at night. Half an hour later, I was waiting for my luggage at baggage claim.
dialogue.reading: ət ɪˈlɛvən ət ˈnaɪt. ˈhæf ən ˈaʊər ˈleɪtər, aɪ wʌz ˈweɪtɪŋ fər maɪ ˈlʌɡɪdʒ ət ˈbæɡɪdʒ ˌkleɪm.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: No! Everyone was taking their bags, but my bag wasn't there.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ! ˈɛvriwʌn wʌz ˈteɪkɪŋ ðɛr ˈbæɡz, bʌt maɪ ˈbæɡ ˈwʌzənt ˈðɛr.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Oh no! What did you do?
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ ˈnoʊ! ˈwʌt dɪd juː ˈduː?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I showed my boarding pass at the baggage desk in the terminal. They're looking for my bag now.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈʃoʊd maɪ ˈbɔːrdɪŋ ˌpæs ət ðə ˈbæɡɪdʒ ˌdɛsk ɪn ðə ˈtɜːrmɪnəl. ðɛr ˈlʊkɪŋ fər maɪ ˈbæɡ ˈnaʊ.
